title: PPT Toolkit Deck
description: Template-agnostic description of a slide deck. An LLM (or harvest.py) produces a JSON document matching this schema; render.py turns it into a .pptx using either the 'white' or 'wb' template. Every slide picks one of the 5 canonical layouts and fills in that layout's fields -- fields for other layouts are ignored.

title.description: Deck title, used for document metadata.

layout.description: Must be one of the 5 layout names present in both templates/*.pptx files.

title.description: Used by every layout as the title placeholder text.

subtitle.description: Title Slide only: subtitle/byline text (e.g. presenter, date, event).

bullets.description: Half Half / Title and Bullets: bullet body text. Plain strings are level 0; use {text, level} for nested/indented bullets.

message.description: Closing: the closing/thank-you message body text (supports multiple lines via \n).

image.description: Half Half: image to place in the picture placeholder.

path.description: Path to an image file, resolved relative to the deck JSON file.

chart.description: Optional chart data, rendered as a native PowerPoint chart in the body/bullet placeholder (replacing 'bullets' if both are given). Works on 'Half Half' and 'Title and Bullets'; on 'Half Half' the separate 'image' field still targets the picture placeholder independently.

table.description: Optional table data, rendered as a native PowerPoint table in the body area.

source.description: Footnote / data-source citation shown in small print. Currently appended to the body text; a dedicated footnote placeholder is a possible future addition (see README).
